title: mcp
description: Gain visibility into the performance, availability, and health of your apps and infrastructure.
summary: Gain visibility into the performance, availability, and health of your apps and infrastructure.
offersHint: Gain visibility into the performance, availability, and health of your apps and infrastructure. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://monitoring.googleapis.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_timeseries
toolsPreview.description: Lists time series data from the Google Cloud Monitoring API

toolsPreview.name: query_range
toolsPreview.description: Evaluate a PromQL query in a range of time

toolsPreview.name: get_alert_policy
toolsPreview.description: Use this as the primary tool to get information about a specific alerting policy. Alerting policies define the conditions under which you want to be notified about issues with your services. This is useful for understanding the details of a specific alert configuration.

toolsPreview.name: list_alert_policies
toolsPreview.description: Use this as the primary tool to list the alerting policies in a Google Cloud project. Alerting policies define the conditions under which you want to be notified about issues with your services. This is useful for understanding what alerts are currently configured.

toolsPreview.name: get_alert
toolsPreview.description: Use this as the primary tool to get information about a specific alert. An alert is the representation of a violation of an alert policy. This is useful for understanding the details of a specific alert.

toolsPreview.name: list_alerts
toolsPreview.description: Use this as the primary tool to list the alerts in a Google Cloud project. An alert is the representation of a violation of an alert policy. This is useful for understanding current and past violations of an alert policy.

toolsPreview.name: list_metric_descriptors
toolsPreview.description: Use this as the primary tool to discover the types of metrics available in a Google Cloud project. This is a good first step to understanding what data is available for monitoring and building dashboards or alerts.

toolsPreview.name: list_dashboards
toolsPreview.description: Use this as the primary tool to retrieve a list of existing custom monitoring dashboards in a Google Cloud project. Custom monitoring dashboards let users view and analyze data from different sources in the same context. This is useful for understanding what custom dashboards are currently configured and available in a given project.

toolsPreview.name: get_dashboard
toolsPreview.description: Use this as the primary tool to retrieve a single specific custom monitoring dashboard from a Google Cloud project using the resource name of the requested dashboard. Custom monitoring dashboards let users view and analyze data from different sources in the same context. This is often used as a follow on to list_dashboards to get full details on a specific dashboard.
